text.title: Junior Next Pr Checklist Template Output Contract
text.summary: Draft-07 JSON Schema for the next-PR checklist: 3 to 7 items, each permalinked to a review comment, phrased as a yes/no check, labelled `blocking` or `should` with at most one blocker, citing a written team standard or labelled as a mentor preference, flagged for lint automation where a machine can own it, carrying a `new` / `carried` / `done` status with retirement after two consecutive ticks and a pairing session after three carries, plus the deferred list and the junior-ticks-first posting rule. Validator: `scripts/validate-junior-next-pr-checklist-template.py`.

section.title: JSON Schema (draft-07)
section.note: What the schema cannot express and the reviewer checks by hand: `blocking_item_count` equals the number of items with `severity = blocking` and items are ordered by severity (r-severity-ordered-one-blocker); every `origin_permalink` resolves to a comment or diff line on `source_pr.url` (r-item-traces-to-review-comment); an item ticked on two consecutive PRs appears in `retired`, not in `items`, and a third carry appears in `pairing_sessions` (r-carry-forward-and-retire); a `machine_enforceable` item with `prs_since_automation_landed = 1` is dropped on the next checklist (r-machine-checkable-items-become-lint); `deferred` is non-empty whenever the review had more comments than `items` holds (r-three-to-seven-items).

example.note: Subject violations: only two items (r-three-to-seven-items); a trait-phrased item "be more careful ... think about" (r-item-is-verifiable-on-next-pr) that is a mentor preference yet `blocking`, on its fourth carry instead of a pairing session (r-item-cites-team-standard, r-carry-forward-and-retire); two blockers (r-severity-ordered-one-blocker); a formatter-enforceable item with no lint rule or automation ticket (r-machine-checkable-items-become-lint); ticks authored by the mentor and no paste into the PR description (r-junior-self-ticks-before-review); and a checklist marked mentor-confirmed with no date, handed to the junior by the agent.

antipattern.description: A `check` containing "be more", "think about", "try to", "be careful" or "cleaner code", or any phrasing a reviewer cannot answer yes or no on the next PR.
antipattern.reason: r-item-is-verifiable-on-next-pr: a check that cannot be ticked is never ticked and is carried forever.

antipattern.description: More than 7 `items`, or fewer than 3; an empty `deferred` list while the review had more comments than the checklist holds.
antipattern.reason: r-three-to-seven-items: a twenty-item list is read once and never again.

antipattern.description: An item whose `origin_permalink` is missing, is not a comment or diff-line anchor, or does not point at `source_pr.url`.
antipattern.reason: r-item-traces-to-review-comment: general advice belongs in the style guide, not the junior's checklist.

antipattern.description: `carried_count` of 3 or more on an item, or an item ticked on two consecutive PRs still in `items` instead of `retired`.
antipattern.reason: r-carry-forward-and-retire: a checklist that only grows is a record of the junior's sins.
r-machine-checkable-items-become-lint: every item a machine can own frees a slot for judgement.
r-junior-self-ticks-before-review: self-assessment is where the learning happens.

antipattern.description: `blocking_item_count` above 1, or a `blocking` item whose `standard.kind` is `preference`.
antipattern.reason: r-severity-ordered-one-blocker, r-item-cites-team-standard: if everything is blocking nothing is, and taste is not law.

antipattern.description: `review.handed_to_junior_by_agent` true, or `mentor_confirmed` without the confirmation date.
antipattern.reason: Human checkpoint in `03-failure-modes.xml`: the mentor confirms every permalink and severity before the junior sees the list.

text.reference: Stdlib-only validator for this contract; `--self-test` runs both examples above.
Checklist skeleton the junior pastes into the next PR description, with the same fields.
